info.name: E-Commerce Platform (Spring Boot Microservices)
info.description:
End-to-end API collection for the e-commerce microservices platform.

1. Start the stack: `docker compose up -d --build`
2. Select the **Local** environment
3. Run the collection (Runner) top to bottom — it works as an end-to-end test.

Default auth is the customer's bearer token; admin requests override it. Docs: backend/microservices/docs/STEP-BY-STEP-FLOW.md

item.name: 0. Auth (run first)
item.description: Gets access tokens from Keycloak and stores them in the environment.
